reviewer: Codex agent, source-grounded manual adjudication; not independent human review

criteria.correct: Answerable: a delivered Ollama answer resolves the core question with supported claims. Unanswerable: no_evidence with no invented answer. Fallback does not pass.
criteria.complete: Answer prose explicitly covers all facts in expected_answer. Citation text alone does not fill omissions.
criteria.all_claims_supported: Every delivered claim is supported by its cited text. Null for refusals with no claims.

limitations: Same 12 AI-authored development questions and historical v0.1 corpus; no held-out or real-user validation.
Current v0.2 supports .env loading; OPS04 measures fidelity to a frozen historical source.
Some answers remain verbose; OPS05 omits nonempty, and OPS02 dense/hybrid omit explicit PowerShell 7 wording.
Source selection guarantees provenance and exact text, not semantic entailment.
